## Known issues fixed as part of this cleanup

- **ATPase/Abcb4 heritability figures were swapped.** `figures/ATPase/h2.jpg` and `figures/Abcb4/h2.jpg` had each other's plot (confirmed visually: title text on the image itself named the other protein). Every other protein's heritability figure was already correct. The two files have been swapped to match their filenames.
- **Genome-scan carousels rendered as broken/literal code.** The carousel HTML generated by `build_chapters.py` had blank lines between `<div class="carousel-item">` blocks. A blank line ends a raw-HTML block in Pandoc/CommonMark, so the indented lines after it (4+ spaces) were parsed as an indented code block instead of continuing as HTML -- the carousel showed up as literal tag text instead of an image slider. Fixed by making the whole carousel one contiguous HTML block with no internal blank lines.
- **RNA-mediation image filename mismatch.** The figure-generation script names its output `genome_wide_rna_med_page_001.jpg`; the old chapter template hardcoded `genome_wide_mediators_page_001.jpg` (only matching Ent1's older naming). This broke the image for every other protein that otherwise had this figure. The generator now checks both names.
- **TIMBR was never actually shown.** Real TIMBR output exists for 26 of 27 proteins (only Ces2 has none), but the `### TIMBR` section was `include=FALSE` and fully commented out in every chapter. It's now wired in wherever a TIMBR figure exists, using the dedicated allelic-series dot plots for Cyp2c39/Cyp2c50 where available.
- **Duplicate/stale figure trees.** `figs/`, the top-level `figures/`, and an accidental nested `figures/figures/` copy inside this book have been merged into (or removed in favor of) `figures/` here, which is what the current figure-generation pipeline (`run_final_fig.sh`) actually writes to.

## Headline gap: merge / diplotype fine-mapping

Merge/diplotype analysis -- founder-haplotype-resolved fine-mapping at significant loci -- has only been run for **Bsep** and **Cyp2c39** (plus a partial run for **Cyp2c50** that did the diplotype filtering step but surfaced no significant SNPs). The remaining ~24 proteins have not had this analysis run at all. See the `merge/` and `out/Merge/` columns in the table above, and `R/Merge/` for the scripts (`Bsep_Merge.R`, `cyp2c39merge.R`, `cyp_Merge.R`, `sub_cyp_Merge.R` and variants) that would need to be re-run/generalized for the remaining proteins.

## Other partial coverage

- **pQTL scans**: several proteins are missing one or more of the box-cox / RINT / full-dataset scan variants (e.g. Oct1.2, Ugt1a1, Ugt1a6 have essentially no scan output yet).
- **RNA mediation**: about half the panel has no mediation analysis run at all; a few more have the underlying RDS result but no rendered genome-wide figure yet.

Both are visible per-protein in the table above and in each protein's own chapter (look for "_Not yet analyzed here_" notes).
